title: Dunlop
html_source: Irish theosophist, well up in theosophy circles.

anchor.prefix: nly man. Hiesos Kristos, magician of the beautiful, the Logos who suffers in us at every moment. This verily is that. I am the fire upon the altar. I am the sacrificial butter.
